title: DriveSure Plan Schedule: Price, Term and Vehicle Limits
content:
Vehicle Service Contracts are sold in six DriveSure plans, ranked from DriveSure Powertrain (rank 1, the lowest) to DriveSure Exclusionary (rank 6). This schedule sets, for every plan, the retail price financed in the retail installment contract, the coverage term and the vehicle age and odometer limits a vehicle must be within to be enrolled.

## Price, term and entry limits

| Plan | Rank | Retail price (USD) | Term (months from the enrollment date) | Coverage mileage (miles added to the odometer at sale) | Maximum vehicle age (years) | Maximum odometer at sale (miles) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DriveSure Powertrain | 1 | 1295.00 | 24 | 24000 | 12 | 150000 |
| DriveSure Powertrain Plus | 2 | 1595.00 | 36 | 36000 | 12 | 140000 |
| DriveSure Silver | 3 | 1895.00 | 36 | 36000 | 10 | 125000 |
| DriveSure Gold | 4 | 2295.00 | 48 | 48000 | 8 | 100000 |
| DriveSure Platinum | 5 | 2695.00 | 48 | 60000 | 7 | 85000 |
| DriveSure Exclusionary | 6 | 3195.00 | 60 | 60000 | 6 | 75000 |

The retail price is the retail price of the service contract, financed in the retail installment contract, in USD. The term runs in months from the enrollment date; the coverage mileage is added to the odometer at sale.

## Terms common to every plan

| Term | Every plan, Powertrain through Exclusionary |
|---|---|
| Sold only at contract signing | Yes: the service contract can be financed only at contract signing |
| Commercial use | Excluded: vehicles used commercially, for rideshare or livery are ineligible |
| Administrator | DriveSure Administrative Services, LLC, the third-party administrator that adjudicates and pays claims |
| Service contracts in force at once on one financed vehicle | 1 |
| When coverage ends | the earlier of the expiration date and the expiration odometer |

## Reading the schedule

- **Expiration point (hypothetical vehicle).** A DriveSure Gold contract enrolled with an odometer at sale of 30000 miles has an expiration odometer of 78000 miles (30000 plus 48000) and an expiration date 48 months after the enrollment date; coverage ends at whichever of the two is reached first.
- **Entry limits.** Each plan carries both an age limit and an odometer limit. A vehicle showing 90000 miles at sale (hypothetical) is above the DriveSure Platinum limit of 85000 miles and the DriveSure Exclusionary limit of 75000 miles, and within the limits of the DriveSure Gold, Silver, Powertrain Plus and Powertrain plans as far as the odometer is concerned; its age is read against the age column separately.
